content: Group 1: Mutations Associated with Resistance (Meeting Five Criteria) 1. The total number of isolates (both resistant and susceptible) containing the mutation as a SOLO mutation must be at least 5. 2. The lower bound of the 95% confidence interval for the positive predictive value (PPV) of the mutation, when present as a SOLO mutation, must be at least 25%. 3. The odds ratio (OR) for the mutation must be greater than 1. This criterion is automatically satisfied if the fourth criterion is met. 4. The odds ratio for the mutation as a SOLO mutation (OR SOLO) must be greater than 1. 5. The statistical significance of the OR SOLO must be confirmed using Fisher’s exact test, with corrections for the false discovery rate. Criteria 4 and 5 are combined in the OR SOLO column of the simplified tables in the report. If both criteria are met, the results are highlighted in red. Group 2: Mutations Associated with Resistance (Interim, Relaxed Criteria for pncA) 1. The number of resistant isolates containing the mutation as a SOLO mutation must be at least 2. 2. The positive predictive value (PPV) of the mutation must be at least 50%. Group 3: Mutations of Uncertain Significance These mutations do not meet the criteria for inclusion in Groups 1, 2, 4, or 5. Their association with drug resistance remains unclear. Group 4: Mutations Not Associated with Resistance (Interim) These include silent mutations that do not meet the requirements for other groups. Additionally, mutations meeting the relaxed criteria for pncA are included if the upper bound of the 95% confidence interval for the PPV as a SOLO mutation is less than 75%. Group 5: Mutations Not Associated with Resistance These are neutral mutations that were excluded prior to the application of the algorithm. Example of Mutation Analysis In one example, a mutation in the rpoB gene at codon 445 (MTBC numbering) results in an amino acid change from serine to leucine. This corresponds to codon 526 in the previous Escherichia coli nomenclature. The mutation was identified in 20 phenotypically susceptible isolates and 217 resistant isolates. It was absent in 30,512 susceptible isolates and 16,593 resistant isolates. The sensitivity, specificity, and PPV of this mutation were calculated to assess its ability to predict resistance. When the mutation occurred as a SOLO mutation, its statistical performance was evaluated using the midpoint PPV, the lower and upper bounds of the 95% confidence interval, and the odds ratio (OR SOLO). The OR SOLO was greater than 1 and statistically significant. Confidence Grading The initial confidence grading for this mutation was consistent across the WHO and ALL datasets. No additional grading criteria were applied, so the final confidence grading remained unchanged. In contrast, the initial grading for another mutation (rpoB Leu430Pro) was revised based on additional grading rules. Terms and Abbreviations AwR: Associated with resistance. AwR-I: Associated with resistance (interim). Not AwR: Not associated with resistance. Not AwR-I: Not associated with resistance (interim). Uncert. Sig.: Uncertain significance. WHO-end. gDST: WHO-endorsed genotypic drug susceptibility testing assay.
